purpose: Build an internally stored, normalized, provenance-preserving historical library for lottery draws, slot jackpots, jackpot cycles, awards, configurations and future domains so EDGE can query and test hypotheses without relying on ad-hoc web consultation.

backend.importSecurity: Bearer EDGE_LIBRARY_ADMIN_TOKEN required; if no token is configured, public import is impossible.

timePrecision.SECOND: Exact or source-published timestamp to second resolution.
timePrecision.MINUTE: Minute known but seconds not authoritative.
timePrecision.DATE_ONLY: Official date known; no fabricated draw time is allowed.
timePrecision.UNKNOWN: Temporal placement is incomplete and must remain explicit.

provenanceClasses.INTERNAL_DIRECT_OBSERVATION: EDGE direct telemetry persisted from the canonical public feed.
provenanceClasses.SECONDARY_REFERENCE: External historical tracker, research paper or archive used only with explicit transfer guards.

currentBootstrap.scopeWarning: This bootstrap starts the internal archive; it is not yet the complete historical universe. Coverage must be expanded by verified bulk backfill while preserving source and temporal precision.

worldScaleDesign.goal: Largest auditable research library possible, not the largest pile of unverified rows.
worldScaleDesign.reason: archivePartition is mandatory so historical material can later be split across storage shards or object storage without changing the app query model.

researchUse: Exact reproducible backtests with frozen discovery/validation/holdout partitions.
Cycle and reset distribution analysis without hand-copying observations.
Lottery combination/frequency calculations using complete dated rows rather than aggregate summaries.
Configuration-change detection by comparing rules fingerprints across time.
Cross-operator and cross-market comparisons while preserving jurisdiction boundaries.
Mass hypothesis testing with explicit multiple-testing and out-of-sample controls.
